Name: EasyChests - Portable Categorized Warehouse
Author: lljxww
Description:
[left][center][size=6][b]EasyChests[/b][/size]
[size=4]Portable Categorized Warehouse · 便携分类仓库[/size]
By lljxww | Version 0.21.0 | English / 简体中文[/center]

[size=5][b]English[/b][/size]

Press [b]G[/b] to open your warehouse anywhere and [b]V[/b] to deposit backpack items into their categories. Find your stock, keep supplies on hand, reserve donations and use warehouse materials for crafting, cooking, tool upgrades, Robin's buildings and optional Automate networks.

[b]Requires Stardew Valley 1.6.15+ and SMAPI 4.1.10+. Single-player and multiplayer personal/shared storage, with keyboard/mouse. English and Simplified Chinese are included; the UI follows the game language by default.[/b]

[b]New saves start with personal warehouses.[/b] The host can permanently enable sharing through Settings → Deposit or GMCM. Read and confirm the notice, then [b]save the game and reload that save[/b]. All personal stock, including offline players, merges into shared storage; unlocks and machine exclusions use the union, and minimum reserves use the highest value. Quality, custom item data and Protected Storage are retained. Bookmarks and carry targets remain personal. Existing EasyChests shared saves stay shared. This choice belongs to the save and cannot be undone through configuration; [b]back up your save before confirming[/b].

[size=4][b]Storage that grows with your farm[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]89 categories[/b] organized under ten navigation groups, with an All view. Miscellaneous/Mod Items, Ore, Basic Materials and Spring Crops start unlocked. Community Bundles and Museum Donations are also free in both new and existing saves. Unlock the remaining categories with gold; prices appear in the menu.[/*]
[*][b]72-slot pages[/b] with storage that expands as needed. There is no configured capacity limit; practical limits depend on memory, save size and game performance.[/*]
[*][b]Category favorites and item bookmarks[/b] provide quick access. Category favorites appear in a separate column; an optional setting hides unlocked empty categories. Item bookmarks reference the original stacks without duplicating stock.[/*]
[*][b]Global search[/b] by item name, qualified ID or category name. Withdraw, ship or locate actual stacks directly from results. Processing filters find ingredients for brewing, preserves, juice, pickles, drying and fish smoking without moving them.[/*]
[*][b]Quality stars and stack counts[/b] remain visible in storage, search, bookmark, filter and backpack views.[/*]
[*][b]Organization[/b] includes refill existing items, sort current category and sort warehouse. Ordinary gap compaction preserves item order without extra sorting or merging.[/*]
[/list]Items whose category is still locked stay in Miscellaneous/Mod Items until unlocked and reclassified. Unknown items from other mods also have this fallback.

[size=4][b]Deposit and keep supplies on hand[/b][/size]
Press [b]V[/b] to deposit eligible backpack stock. Common tools, warehouse terminals and items marked [b]Carry All[/b] stay with you. Optional toolbar protection also retains the first 12 backpack slots.

Select an item and click [b]Carry[/b] to set a target quantity across all stacks and qualities of that item. Deposits move only the surplus; [b]Refill Carry[/b] retrieves available stock from ordinary warehouse categories. It respects purchased backpack capacity, stops when full or out of stock, and does not draw from collection reserves, Protected Storage or the shipping bin.

[b]Auto Deposit is off by default.[/b] Enable it on the main toolbar or in Settings to deposit when at most one purchased backpack slot is free. It follows carry and toolbar rules and never sells items.

[size=4][b]Craft, cook, upgrade tools and build from storage[/b][/size]
Ordinary warehouse materials are available to [b]vanilla crafting, cooking and Clint's tool upgrades[/b], enabled by default. [b]Robin's construction and building upgrades[/b] have a separate setting, also enabled by default. Material checks, displayed availability and consumption include eligible warehouse stock; backpack stock and vanilla material sources are used first.

No physical terminal is needed for these uses. Tools still need to be carried for upgrades, and gold, placement, upgrade conditions and waiting times follow the game rules. Ordinary chests participate only where vanilla workbench/fridge rules already allow them. Other shops, gifts and donations are not handled automatically.

[size=4][b]Donation reserves and protected items[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Community Bundles[/b] keeps only the outstanding quantities at sufficient quality for unfinished bundle ingredients. Completed slots and choose-N bundles are accounted for; surplus returns to ordinary categories. Reserves are released when no longer needed, when joining Joja or when the setting is disabled.[/*]
[*][b]Museum Donations[/b] keeps one copy of each item the museum still accepts. Duplicates and donated items return to ordinary categories. Disable the setting to release its reserves.[/*]
[*]Both settings default to on. Reserved stock is excluded from crafting, cooking, tool upgrades, construction, carry restocking and Automate. Gold [b]C / M[/b] indicators show pending quantities; grey means none. Click an indicator, withdraw the items and submit them manually.[/*]
[*][b]Protected Storage[/b] is a separate free category for manual storage. Its contents are excluded from automatic material use and are not moved to ordinary categories by Sort Warehouse.[/*]
[/list][b]After withdrawing from Community Bundles or Museum Donations, Auto Deposit leaves that item in your backpack for the rest of the game day.[/b] The next day, only quantities still needed are returned, respecting carry targets and toolbar protection. Items you already donated or removed are not recreated. Manual quick deposit, menu deposits and quick-stack still work.

[b]Reserves and Protected Storage still allow manual withdrawal and explicit shipping.[/b] They do not donate items for you. Bookmarks only help you find items; carry targets govern deposit/restocking; machine permissions and reserves govern Automate. None of those item flags is a general protection against crafting, manual use or shipping. Check the selected-item status line and hold Shift over a tooltip for full protection details.

[size=4][b]Optional Automate integration[/b][/size]
Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate 2.6.1+[/url], buy a [b]Portable Warehouse Terminal for 2,500g[/b] in the warehouse menu and place it beside machines in an Automate network. Right-click a placed terminal to access the warehouse. The terminal has its own wood-and-copper sprite and green connection panel.

In personal mode, terminals use their placer's warehouse; multiple terminals placed by the same player share that inventory. Shared mode uses one inventory for all terminals. Machines draw from unlocked ordinary categories and deposit output back into the corresponding warehouse. Opening a warehouse pauses that warehouse's terminals; removing a terminal does not delete stock. Terminal networks do not merge with vanilla Junimo Chest networks.

Open [b]Settings → Materials → Vanilla Machine Settings[/b] to select a vanilla machine and check its supported inputs. Products are listed even before you own them, including fuel where applicable. Search by name or ID; [b]Select All / Deselect All[/b] affects every listed input for the current machine, including other pages and search-hidden inputs. Changes save immediately and share the existing item-specific rules.

Select an item and open [b]Machines[/b] to allow or block its supported machines. Set [b]Machine Reserve[/b] to keep a minimum warehouse quantity away from Automate. For example, allow Keg and disable Preserves Jar for starfruit to permit automatic wine production while preventing jam production from warehouse stock.

Supported machines are allowed by default. Permissions and reserves are shared across qualities of the same item, affect warehouse Automate inputs and do not restrict manual processing or crafting. Native recipe, fuel and quantity requirements still apply. Third-party custom Automate factories may need separate integration.

[size=4][b]Shipping[/b][/size]
Open the Shipping Bin view or use [b]Alt + left-click[/b] on a shippable stack; on Mac, use [b]Option + left-click[/b]. Items move into the farm's native shipping bin and sell overnight. You can retrieve them before then. Shipping works from the backpack, ordinary storage, protected storage and search/bookmark/filter results. Automatic deposit never ships items.

[size=4][b]Installation and updating[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI 4.1.10+[/url] for Stardew Valley 1.6.15+.[/*]
[*]Close the game and back up your save.[/*]
[*]Create the game's Mods/EasyChests folder and extract the contents of [b]EasyChests-0.21.0.zip[/b] directly into it. Check that this folder contains manifest.json and EasyChests.dll.[/*]
[*]Launch through SMAPI, load a save and press G. A six-page help guide opens on first use; reopen it anytime with the top [b]?[/b] button.[/*]
[/list]For updates, replace the mod files, keep your own [b]config.json[/b] and install only one copy. Existing warehouse IDs and purchase records are retained. No separate .NET runtime, Chests Anywhere, Bigger Backpack or StardewHack installation is required for EasyChests.

Automate is optional. Without it, storage, search, carry refill, crafting/building materials and shipping remain available; Machine Rules, Machine Reserve and Vanilla Machine Settings controls are hidden. Physical terminals can still open the warehouse. Install the complete ZIP, including EasyChests.Automate.dll, which is the optional integration adapter. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu 1.12.0+[/url] is also optional and adds configuration and keybinding editing. If you use Stardrop, enable the relevant mods in the active profile.

[size=4][b]Language, settings and controls[/b][/size]
The main toolbar provides [b]Language, Auto Deposit and Settings[/b]. Settings groups deposit/carry, browsing/display and materials/collections; changes save immediately, including in-menu slot size changes. Carry, bookmark and machine controls sit below the backpack.

Help keeps a readable font size in small windows. Scroll over its text or use Up/Down to read long pages; Home/End jumps to the beginning/end and PageUp/PageDown changes guide pages. Hover a machine or product name to read it in full.

[b]Follow game is the default:[/b] a Chinese game UI selects Simplified Chinese; all other game languages select English. Auto mode responds to game language changes. The Language button cycles [b]Follow game → English → Simplified Chinese[/b]. You can also select Language in GMCM or set it to "auto", "en" or "zh-CN" in config.json while the game is closed. Fixed choices override the game language. Old English configurations migrate once to Follow game on upgrade; old Chinese choices remain fixed. Select English again if you prefer it. Game and third-party item names, descriptions and machine names use their own translations.

[list]
[*][b]G:[/b] open the warehouse or return through menus. [b]V:[/b] deposit backpack items when free to interact.[/*]
[*][b]Left-click:[/b] select an item. [b]Ctrl + left-click:[/b] quick transfer.[/*]
[*][b]Shift + left-click:[/b] pick up a stack in ordinary storage; locate its original stack in search/bookmark/filter views. [b]Right-click:[/b] split stacks in ordinary storage.[/*]
[*][b]Alt/Option + left-click:[/b] ship a full stack. Alt+Ctrl prioritizes shipping; Alt+Shift keeps the Shift action.[/*]
[*][b]Left/Right or Tab/Shift+Tab:[/b] switch categories when no input or modal has focus. Locked categories are skipped by default.[/*]
[*][b]Mouse wheel, PageUp/PageDown or page buttons:[/b] change pages. Scroll over the backpack or use its arrow buttons to access additional purchased slots.[/*]
[*][b]Ctrl+F:[/b] focus search. [b]Enter:[/b] apply the active input. The search × clears text; Return to Category clears search and filters.[/*]
[*][b]Esc:[/b] return through dialogs, input focus, search and filters, then close. Letter keys such as G/V go to the focused text input.[/*]
[*][b]? / C / M:[/b] reopen help or open pending bundle/museum items.[/*]
[/list]Edit keybindings in GMCM or the generated config.json using OpenKey, ArchiveKey, PreviousCategoryKey and NextCategoryKey. Custom bindings are preserved when migrating older default keys.

[size=4][b]Saves, compatibility and support[/b][/size]
You can add EasyChests to an existing save. Items use native save inventories, separated by player in personal mode; unlocks, carry rules, bookmarks and machine rules persist with normal game saves. UI preferences stay in the local config.json. Resetting configuration does not revert shared mode. Save before quitting.

[b]Before uninstalling, withdraw warehouse items, recover placed terminals and save.[/b] Removing the mod does not return stored items to your backpack. Reinstalling the same mod ID restores access to retained warehouse data.

EasyChests does not increase backpack or ordinary chest capacity. It supports purchased Bigger Backpack slots. [b]Controller navigation is unsupported.[/b] Custom Automate factories and crafting frameworks that bypass vanilla APIs need separate integration; unknown item classification is not a promise of universal mod compatibility.

[b]Multiplayer[/b]: The host and every online player need the same EasyChests version. Personal mode allows concurrent access to separate warehouses; each player manages their own unlocks, machine permissions, reserves and donation settings. Shared mode uses one queue and only the host changes shared rules. Menus pause Automate for the affected inventory, and shipping also needs farm shipping access. While waiting, crafting/building menus use vanilla material sources. Warehouse Automate runs only on the host. Split-screen follows the same modes with keyboard/mouse. Bookmarks and carry targets remain personal; UI preferences use the local configuration. Cursor items use synchronized temporary storage for recovery after interrupted access. Unsynchronized changes cannot be recovered after a client crash. Disconnect/reconnect, save/reload and high-latency play still need testing with a backup or test save.

If G does not open the warehouse, check SMAPI load errors, close other menus/text input and check keybinding conflicts. If Automate does not take an item, check the terminal network, storage category, machine permission, reserve quantity and recipe requirements.

For bug reports, include your operating system, Stardew Valley/SMAPI/EasyChests versions, optional integration versions, reproduction steps, expected/actual results and a [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log link[/url].

[center][size=5][b]简体中文说明[/b][/size][/center]

按 [b]G[/b] 随时打开仓库，按 [b]V[/b] 将背包物品分类入库。快速查找库存、补齐随身用品、保留待提交物品，让制作、烹饪、工具升级、罗宾建造和可选的 Automate 机器网络使用对应仓库的材料。

[b]需要星露谷物语 1.6.15+ 与 SMAPI 4.1.10+。支持单人、多人个人仓库与共享仓库，使用键盘鼠标。内置英文及简体中文，界面默认跟随游戏语言。[/b]

[b]新存档默认每人独立仓库。[/b]房主可在「设置 → 归档与随身」或 GMCM 请求永久共享，阅读并确认后，[b]先保存游戏，再重新加载此存档[/b]。合并全部个人库存，包括离线玩家；分类解锁和禁用机器取并集，最低保留量取最大值，保留物品品质、自定义数据与不消耗分类。收藏与随身目标仍按玩家保存。已有 EasyChests 共享存档保持共享。模式属于存档，重置配置无法撤销，也没有拆分回个人仓库的选项；[b]确认前请备份存档[/b]。

[size=4][b]随农场逐步成长的仓库[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]89 个分类[/b]，按十组导航，另有「全部分类」总览。初始开放「待分类与模组物品」「矿石」「基础材料」「春季作物」；「社区收集」「博物馆」在新旧存档中均免费开放。其余分类用金币解锁，界面会显示价格。[/*]
[*]每页 [b]72 格[/b]，库存按需扩容，没有配置容量上限；实际仍受内存、存档大小与游戏性能限制。[/*]
[*][b]分类收藏与物品收藏[/b]方便快速访问。分类收藏显示在独立列，可选隐藏已解锁空分类；物品收藏引用原库存，不创建第二份物品。[/*]
[*][b]全仓搜索[/b]支持物品名、限定 ID 或分类名，结果可直接取出、出货或定位来源。加工用途筛选查找可酿酒、做果酱、榨汁、腌制、烘干或熏鱼的原料，不改变库存位置。[/*]
[*][b]品质星标与堆叠数量[/b]同时显示，覆盖仓库、搜索、收藏、筛选与菜单内背包。[/*]
[*][b]整理操作[/b]包括补入已有、整理当前分类和整理全仓；普通补空位保持原有顺序，不额外排序或合并。[/*]
[/list]尚未解锁分类的物品暂存「待分类与模组物品」，解锁后重新归类；无法识别的其他模组物品也使用这一兜底分类。

[size=4][b]归档与补齐随身[/b][/size]
按 [b]V[/b] 归档符合条件的背包物品。常用工具、仓库终端及标为[b]「全部随身」[/b]的物品保留在背包；可选的工具栏保护会保留背包前 12 格。

选中物品后点击[b]「随身」[/b]，设置同一物品跨堆叠、跨品质合计的目标数量，归档只存入超额部分。[b]「补齐随身」[/b]从普通仓库库存补足目标，遵守背包已购买容量，满包或缺货时只取可容纳的现有数量，不取用收集保留、不消耗分类或出货箱中的物品。

[b]自动入库默认关闭。[/b]在主界面顶部或「设置」中开启后，背包已购买格子剩余不超过一格时自动归档，遵守随身和工具栏保护规则，不会出售物品。

[size=4][b]直接使用仓库材料制作、烹饪、升级与建造[/b][/size]
普通仓库材料可用于[b]原版制作、烹饪和克林特工具升级[/b]，默认开启。[b]罗宾建造与建筑升级[/b]使用独立设置，也默认开启。材料检查、菜单可用数量和实际扣除均包含符合条件的仓库库存，优先使用背包及原版已有材料来源。

这些功能无需放置终端。升级工具仍需携带工具本体；金币、建筑摆放、升级条件与等待时间遵循游戏规则。普通箱子仅在原版工作台／冰箱规则允许时参与，不会全地图接入。其他商店交易、赠礼、献祭和捐赠不自动接管。

[size=4][b]收集保留与物品保护[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]社区收集[/b]仅保留未完成献祭尚需的数量及合格品质，考虑已提交项目与任选若干项的献祭；多余数量归入普通分类。不再需要、加入 Joja 或关闭设置时释放对应保留。[/*]
[*][b]博物馆[/b]每种游戏仍接受捐赠的物品保留一件，重复和已捐赠物品回归普通分类；关闭设置后释放保留。[/*]
[*]两项策略默认开启。保留库存不用于制作、烹饪、工具升级、建造、补齐随身或 Automate。「社」「博」指示灯为金色时显示待提交数量，为灰色时表示没有；点击打开对应分类，再手动取出提交。[/*]
[*][b]不消耗[/b]是免费的独立分类，仅手动存放，隔离自动用料；整理全仓不会将其中物品移回普通分类。[/*]
[/list][b]从社区收集或博物馆主动取出后，当天自动入库会将该物品留在背包。[/b]次日仅收回仍然欠缺的数量，遵守随身目标和工具栏保护；已提交或移走的物品不会重新生成。V 主动归档、菜单归档、补入已有和单独放回仍可使用。

[b]收集保留与不消耗分类仍允许手动取出和主动出货，不会自动献祭或捐赠。[/b]收藏只方便查找，随身目标只控制归档与补齐，机器权限和保留量只限制 Automate；这些物品标记都不是对制作、手动使用或出货的全面保护。选中物品查看底部状态行，悬停时按住 Shift 可展开完整保护说明。

[size=4][b]可选 Automate 自动化[/b][/size]
安装 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate 2.6.1+[/url]，在仓库界面花费 [b]2,500 金购买仓库终端[/b]，放在 Automate 机器网络中的机器旁即可接入库存。放置后右键访问仓库，终端使用独立的木铜贴图与绿色连接面板。

个人模式按终端放置者使用其仓库，同一玩家的多个终端共用库存；共享模式下全部终端共用库存。机器读取对应仓库的已解锁普通分类，产出自动归档。打开仓库时暂停对应库存的终端自动化；拆除终端不删除仓库物品。终端网络不与原版祝尼魔箱网络合并。

打开[b]「设置 → 用料与收集 → 原版机器设置」[/b]，选择原版机器后勾选它支持的投料产品，含适用的燃料；尚未持有的产品也可预先设置。支持按名称或 ID 搜索，[b]「全选／取消全选」[/b]作用于当前机器的完整产品列表，包含其他页面和搜索隐藏的产品；修改立即保存，并与已有物品权限同步。

选中物品后打开[b]「机器操作」[/b]，逐项允许或禁止支持的机器；通过[b]「机器保留」[/b]设置不允许 Automate 消耗的最低仓库数量。例如杨桃只允许「小桶」、禁止「罐头瓶」，即可自动酿酒并避免自动做果酱。

默认允许全部支持的机器，同一物品的各品质共用权限与保留量。这些设置只限制本模组仓库的 Automate 进料，不限制手动加工或制作；仍需满足机器原有配方、燃料与数量条件。第三方自定义 Automate 工厂可能需要单独适配。

[size=4][b]快捷出货[/b][/size]
进入「出货箱」视图，或对可出货物品按 [b]Alt + 左键[/b]，Mac 使用 [b]Option + 左键[/b]，将整堆移入农场原生出货箱。物品过夜出售，过夜前可取回。支持背包、普通分类、不消耗分类以及搜索／收藏／筛选结果。归档和自动入库不会出售物品。

[size=4][b]安装与更新[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]为星露谷物语 1.6.15+ 安装 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI 4.1.10+[/url]。[/*]
[*]退出游戏并备份存档。[/*]
[*]创建游戏 Mods/EasyChests 目录，将 [b]EasyChests-0.21.0.zip[/b] 的内容直接解压到该目录，确认其中存在 manifest.json 和 EasyChests.dll。[/*]
[*]使用 SMAPI 启动，载入存档后按 G。首次打开显示六页帮助，顶部[b]「?」[/b]可随时重看。[/*]
[/list]升级时替换模组文件，保留自己的 [b]config.json[/b]，只安装一份 EasyChests；库存 ID 与已有购买记录保持不变。不需要另装 .NET 运行时，也不要求安装 Chests Anywhere、Bigger Backpack 或 StardewHack。

Automate 为可选依赖。未安装时，仓库存取、搜索、随身补齐、制作／建造用料与出货功能仍可正常使用，界面隐藏「机器操作」「机器保留」和「原版机器设置」；实体终端仍可打开仓库。请安装完整 ZIP，包含可选集成适配器 EasyChests.Automate.dll。[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu 1.12.0+[/url] 同样可选，用于游戏内配置和快捷键编辑。使用 Stardrop 时，在当前配置中启用对应模组。

[size=4][b]语言、设置与快捷键[/b][/size]
主界面顶部提供[b]「语言」「自动入库」「设置」[/b]。「设置」按归档与随身、浏览与显示、用料与收集分组，修改立即保存，格子大小也可在菜单内调整。随身、收藏与机器规则集中在背包下方。

帮助在小窗口中保持可读字号；鼠标移到正文后用滚轮，或使用上下方向键阅读长内容，Home/End 跳至首尾，PageUp/PageDown 切换帮助页。悬停机器或产品名称可查看完整文字。

[b]默认跟随游戏：[/b]中文游戏使用简体中文，其他游戏语言使用英文；自动模式会响应游戏内语言切换。语言按钮循环选择[b]「跟随游戏 → English → 简体中文」[/b]，也可在 GMCM 中选择，或退出游戏后将 config.json 的 Language 设为 "auto"、"en" 或 "zh-CN"。固定语言不随游戏切换。旧版英文配置升级时一次性迁移为跟随游戏，旧版中文配置保留；需要固定英文时重新选择 English。游戏和其他模组提供的物品、机器名称及说明沿用其自身翻译。

[list]
[*][b]G：[/b]打开仓库或逐层返回。[b]V：[/b]玩家可自由操作时归档背包。[/*]
[*][b]左键：[/b]选中物品。[b]Ctrl + 左键：[/b]快捷存取。[/*]
[*][b]Shift + 左键：[/b]普通库存中拾起整堆，搜索／收藏／筛选视图中定位原库存。[b]右键：[/b]普通库存中拆分。[/*]
[*][b]Alt/Option + 左键：[/b]整堆出货。Alt+Ctrl 优先出货，Alt+Shift 保持 Shift 行为。[/*]
[*][b]左右方向键或 Tab/Shift+Tab：[/b]没有输入或弹窗焦点时切换分类，默认跳过未购买分类。[/*]
[*][b]滚轮、PageUp/PageDown 或分页按钮：[/b]库存翻页。在背包区域滚动或使用箭头按钮可访问更多已购买格子。[/*]
[*][b]Ctrl+F：[/b]聚焦搜索。[b]Enter：[/b]应用当前输入。搜索 × 清除搜索文字，「返回分类」同时清除搜索与筛选。[/*]
[*][b]Esc：[/b]逐层关闭弹窗、退出输入、搜索与筛选，再关闭仓库。输入框有焦点时，G/V 等字母用于输入。[/*]
[*][b]? / 社 / 博：[/b]重看帮助或打开待提交分类。[/*]
[/list]快捷键通过 GMCM 或首次运行生成的 config.json 修改，对应 OpenKey、ArchiveKey、PreviousCategoryKey、NextCategoryKey。迁移旧版默认快捷键时保留自定义绑定。

[size=4][b]存档、兼容与反馈[/b][/size]
可加入已有存档。库存使用游戏原生存档存储，个人模式按玩家区分；解锁、随身规则、收藏与机器规则随正常存档保存，界面偏好保存在本机 config.json。重置配置不会恢复个人模式，退出前请保存游戏。

[b]卸载前先取出仓库物品、回收已放置终端并保存。[/b]移除模组不会将仓库物品自动退回背包，重新安装相同模组 ID 可再次访问存档中保留的数据。

不改变背包或普通箱子容量，支持 Bigger Backpack 已购买格数。[b]暂不支持手柄导航。[/b]第三方自定义 Automate 工厂、绕开原版 API 的制作框架需单独适配；能为未知物品提供兜底分类，不代表兼容所有模组行为。

[b]多人游戏[/b]：房主和全部在线玩家必须安装相同版本的 EasyChests。个人模式允许同时操作各自仓库，各自解锁分类、设置机器权限、最低保留及收集保留。共享模式使用同一访问队列，共享规则仅由房主修改。菜单暂停对应库存的 Automate，出货还需取得农场出货访问。制作／建造菜单等待期间使用原版材料；Automate 只在房主端运行。分屏遵循相同模式，使用键盘鼠标。收藏与随身目标按玩家保存，界面偏好按本机配置保存。游标物品通过原生存档库存暂存，可恢复已同步的中断操作；客户端崩溃前尚未传出的变更无法保证恢复。断线重连、保存重启及高延迟流程仍需使用备份或测试存档验证。

按 G 没有打开时，检查 SMAPI 加载错误、关闭其他菜单与文字输入，并检查快捷键冲突。Automate 不取料时，检查终端网络、物品分类、机器权限、保留量和配方条件。

反馈问题请提供操作系统、星露谷物语／SMAPI／EasyChests 版本、可选集成版本、复现步骤、预期与实际结果，以及 [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI 日志链接[/url]。
